explication: KeyStats is a native macOS and Windows menu-bar application for collecting keyboard and mouse aggregates, persisting daily statistics, and presenting summaries, history, and heatmaps. The primary workflow is input capture → aggregate statistics → local persistence and display; optional encrypted sync adds pairing, upload, and history recovery through a server worker. The graph preserves platform-specific capture and UI paths plus sync components. Some subsystem links are based on README capabilities or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
